title: A sample's markup exports into kind folders, each clip file playing its region on the grid
description:
As a beatmaker, I want a sample's sections, loops and one-shots in a folder of my choosing, sorted by kind, each clip file playing exactly its region on the grid, so that I can browse and drag Apricity's markup in the DAW.

File names follow the shared rule of apricitus-f5b805 (`<letter>-<length>-<key> <clip name>.alc`); this story checks the layout and the clip contents, not the naming rule itself.

```gherkin
Feature: A sample's automatic markup exported as a browsable folder of clip files
  Background:
    Given a sample "Thunderer.wav" of 32 bars in 4/4 at 120 BPM in Bb, analyzed
    And its automatic markup has the sections "sec-A1" (bars 1-16) and "sec-B1" (bars 17-32)
    And the loop "loop-1" over bars 3-4
    And the one-shot "shot-1" at bar 20 beat 1

  Scenario: One clip file per section, loop and one-shot, in folders by kind
    When I export the clips of "Thunderer.wav" to "out"
    Then the export succeeds
    And the folder "out/Thunderer" holds exactly:
      | file                              |
      | sections/A-16bars-Bb sec-A1.alc   |
      | sections/B-16bars-Bb sec-B1.alc   |
      | loops/A-2bars-Bb loop-1.alc       |
      | shots/B-1beat-Bb shot-1.alc       |

  Scenario: A clip file plays its region of the sample, warped
    When I export the clips of "Thunderer.wav" to "out"
    Then "out/Thunderer/loops/A-2bars-Bb loop-1.alc" plays "Thunderer.wav" from bar 3 to the end of bar 4
    And it is warped with the sample's warp markers inside that region
    And it loops over its whole length

  Scenario: Sections and one-shots do not loop
    When I export the clips of "Thunderer.wav" to "out"
    Then no clip file under "out/Thunderer/sections" or "out/Thunderer/shots" loops

  Scenario: The clip files reference the sample where it is
    When I export the clips of "Thunderer.wav" to "out"
    Then every clip file under "out/Thunderer" references "Thunderer.wav"
    And no audio file is written under "out"

  Scenario: A stem's folder is named after its recording and stem
    Given a stem "stems/Thunderer/drums.wav" of "Thunderer.wav", analyzed, with no sections and the loop "loop-1" one bar long
    When I export the clips of "stems/Thunderer/drums.wav" to "out"
    Then the folder "out/Thunderer-drums/loops" holds one clip file

  Scenario: The same sample exports the same bytes
    When I export the clips of "Thunderer.wav" to "out" twice with "--force"
    Then every file is identical between the two exports
```
